title: Completeness of the active family
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $\tau$ be rational with $0<\tau\le 1$. Suppose a finite family $\mathcal A$ of subsets of the $n$ coordinates has the property that every frequency set $U$ whose Fourier coefficient for $f$ has magnitude at least $\tau$ has its length-$n$ prefix in $\mathcal A$. Then every such $U$ belongs to $\mathcal A$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
The active invariant holds: every frequency set with Fourier coefficient magnitude at least $\tau$ has its length-$n$ prefix in the active family
$U$ is a frequency set of the $n$ coordinates
The Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $U$ has magnitude at least $\tau$
